# Rad UI - Complete Documentation

> Rad UI is a modern, headless React component library focused on accessibility, TypeScript, and unstyled primitives for building custom design systems.

This file contains key documentation for LLM consumption. For the most up-to-date information, visit https://www.rad-ui.com.

## Introduction

Rad UI is an open-source, headless React component library designed for building accessible, customizable user interfaces. It provides unstyled primitives with built-in accessibility, keyboard navigation, and focus management.

Visit: https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/introduction

## Installation

Install Rad UI via npm, yarn, or pnpm. See the full installation guide for framework-specific setup.

Visit: https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/installation

## Usage

Learn how to use Rad UI components in your React applications with proper styling integration.

Visit: https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/usage

## Key Principles

- **Headless**: Components provide behavior and accessibility without imposing styles
- **Accessible**: Built with WCAG compliance and proper ARIA attributes
- **TypeScript-first**: Full type safety with excellent developer experience
- **Composable**: Flexible API that works with any styling solution
- **Uncontrolled by default**: Supports both controlled and uncontrolled patterns

- GitHub: https://github.com/rad-ui/ui

## Components

Rad UI offers 50+ accessible, headless components. For complete API documentation and examples, visit https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/components.
